summary: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 23:25 - Built 'vw live-subs': live system-audio subtitles in a draggable on-screen overlay with tray control. Found existing pieces rather than writing from scratch: vaultwares-realtime has soundcard WASAPI loopback capture and a PySide6 overlay (frameless/translucent/draggable) but NO tray icon, and it is coupled to vault_themes.VaultThemeManager which I did not want to pull into vw-cli; vault-explorer/python-scripts/live_subtitles.py has the proven Parakeet rolling-buffer segmentation. Vendored the good parts into utils/live_subs_overlay.py (self-contained, no vault_themes dep) and added the missing QSystemTrayIcon. Architecture is 3 threads: AudioThread (soundcard loopback -> bounded queue, drops oldest block when ASR falls behind rather than stalling the audio callback), AsrWorker on its own QThread (rolling buffer, re-transcribe every 0.7s, emits partial/final via Qt signals - kept off the Qt thread so dragging and the tray menu never freeze during a pass), and the Qt main thread. Segmentation reuses the >=2-segments-means-the-older-ones-are-settled rule from vault-explorer, so no VAD and no silence-RMS tuning decides cue ends. Tray menu: start/stop, show/hide, text bigger/smaller, recenter, clear, status, quit. Tray icon is drawn in code (QPainter) so the app needs no asset files. Added ParakeetTranscriber.transcribe_array() for in-memory float32 buffers (the file-based path would cost a WAV round-trip per pass). Added Start-LiveSubtitles.ps1 (launches via pythonw.exe so no console window sits on top of the overlay) and registered 'live-subs' in vw-commands.ps1. Installed soundcard==0.4.6 and PySide6==6.11.1, both dry-run first; torch untouched. VERIFIED: transcribe_array on the known TTS clip returned 3 correct segments with correct timestamps; GUI smoke test confirmed frameless+always-on-top+Tool+translucent flags, tray available and visible, all 8 menu actions present, caption
